scares.description: A hand unexpectedly appears on the bed.

, 1:06:42, 1:24:40, 1:27:07, and 1:30:23 might cause some alarm to sensitive viewers. A couple of these moments verge on jump scare territory but a lack of an accompanying sound effect lessens their impact.
During a flashback young Jessie looks across the bed to see a scary looking bald man (the Moonlight Man) licking her feet.
Jessie looks in the rear vision mirror and sees the deformed bald man.
